newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity funds rise in 2-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity funds rise in 2-day period - survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. equity mutual funds rose to $561 million for the two-day period ended February 20 compared with $118 million for the three-day period ended February 18, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

According to the fund tracker, growth funds posted inflows to $271 million from outflows of $40 million, while growth and income jumped to $466 million from $134 million. International funds recorded inflows of $103 million versus outflows of $84 million.

Bond funds posted a slowdown in inflows to $46 million from $279 million. Government/GNMA posted inflows of $18 million versus $55 million, while muni funds had outflows of $90 million versus inflows of $98 million.
